name: Astrid Tiar
bio: Astrid Tiar is an Indonesian actress.

credits.title: Dominion of Darkness: Rephaim
credits.overview: Following a catastrophic, failed ritual in a remote Indonesian province, two Catholic exorcists are deployed to confront a devastatingly powerful ancient entity unleashed by an ancestral pact for illicit wealth.

credits.title: Wasiat Warisan
credits.overview: Returned to Toba to manage their late parents' abandoned hotel, three siblings face a bitter internal rift when a woman arrives claiming an unpaid debt to seize the property, forcing the brother to navigate a blossoming romance and unearth the secret behind his mother's true will.

credits.title: Dominion of Darkness
credits.overview: After losing his mother and sister, Thomas plans to resign as a priest but is tasked with assisting exorcist Rendra. Together, they confront demons possessing Kayla, his late sister's friend, while her mother Maya battles a haunting past.

credits.title: Tulah 6/13
credits.overview: Five teenagers who decided to go on vacation on June 13 before getting preoccupied with their final college assignments. But their beautiful vacation plans turned tense after the car they were driving was involved in a single accident. credits.title: Target
credits.overview: Trapped in an empty building, nine people are forced to play a lethal game. All their movements will be recorded, and only one player can survive.

credits.title: Ananta
credits.overview: An antisocial teen who acts out develops an invigorating relationship with a new student who has befriended her with a benevolent ulterior motive.

credits.title: Critical Eleven
credits.overview: A happily married couple embarks on a journey in an effort to overcome a tragic loss—and rekindles their love for each other.

credits.title: Cinta/Mati
credits.overview: Acid, who was brokenhearted, decided to end her life. In her attempt to commit suicide, Acid met Jaya. At first, Acid forced Jaya to help her end her life. It turned out, Jaya had the same wish as Acid. They then decided to cooperate in completing the wish in ending their lives.

credits.title: Badai di Ujung Negeri
credits.overview: Badai is a marine assigned to an Indonesian border guard post on an island in the South China Sea.

credits.title: Briptu Idolaku
credits.overview: Astrid, a super famous artist who has many fans. Although successful in a career, Astrid's relationship with her boyfriend, Permana, is problematic.
